meta.description:
This is a 10 band Sentinel 2 ARD COG from the UK Earth Observation Data Hub.  In this visualisation, the red, green and blue bands are used to create a colour composite that presents the data in natural colour, close to how it would be visualised by eye.

The data is in CRS for British National Grid (EPSG 27700), which is added as a custom CRS.
Sentinel 2 ARD.  Source data is "visual" asset from AWS open data.  Pre-processed for three bands in red, green and blue channels.
